checks.sub: Six points we put in writing on every contract.

items.title: The deposit
items.text: One month by law. Extra guarantees are capped at two months' rent. Agents still ask for more. We don't let them.

items.title: Who pays the agent
items.text: The landlord pays their own agent. A fee charged to you is a red flag. You hire us; we do not act for the landlord.

items.title: The rent
items.text: No regional cap in Madrid: the asking price is the market. We say if it is out of line and read the update clause.

items.title: Contract type
items.text: A habitual-residence lease protects you in ways a 'temporada' lease does not. We check which one you are handed, and which charges land on you.

items.title: Registration
items.text: Registered at the town hall with your contract: health card and school place hang on it. We confirm it before you pay.

items.title: Income rules
items.text: Payslips, a bank guarantee, a Spanish guarantor: each landlord asks differently. New job, foreign salary, freelance — we write it so it passes.

truth.p: A tenancy that goes wrong costs us more than a lost fee — so we write down what we saw, before you sign.
flags: a deposit above the legal cap
an agent fee charged to you
a 'temporada' lease for a long stay
a rent out of line with the street

rows.ddHtml: BOOM Madrid, the tenant-side rental desk of BOOM — operated by Egidi Immobiliare S.r.l., a registered Italian agency. You hire us; we do not act for the landlord. Paid by the tenant only.
Internationals relocating to Madrid — employees, researchers, couples and families — from abroad or already in the city.
VAT included. No percentage of the rent, nothing from landlords or platforms.
Spanish-format file in 24 hours, applications within the hour, attended viewings with live video and written report, negotiation, contract check against the LAU, padrón supported.
We don't list homes, we don't represent landlords, we don't promise a date.

items.q: Isn't it the landlord who pays the agent in Spain now?
items.a: Yes: the landlord bears their own agency costs. That rule covers the landlord's agent. You can still hire your own, who works only for you, and pay for that work. That is what we are, and we never take anything from landlords or their agents.

items.q: How fast will I have an apartment?
items.a: Budget and move-in date decide it. A complete Spanish-format file and applications inside the hour are what shorten it. Nobody can promise a date in Madrid. Anyone who does is selling you something else.

items.q: Do I need to be in Madrid?
items.a: No. A BOOM person attends viewings in your place, with live video and a written report. The contract is checked and signed remotely. You arrive for the keys and the padrón.

items.q: What if you don't find anything?
items.a: Then we talk. We say in the first call if your budget and timeline don't fit the market, and we would rather decline a search than take one we don't believe in — if we decline, Full Search is refunded in full.
By card on this page (Stripe) when you start, or by bank transfer against an invoice from Egidi Immobiliare S.r.l. Flat fees, VAT included. Nothing from landlords, their agents or platforms.

items.q: What do you do with my data?
items.a: It is used to answer you and to run your search, and for nothing else. No resale, no mailing lists. Ask us to delete it and we will.

band.p: One minute now — a reply the same working day.
